page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.26xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated compute resources, the ecs.r6.26xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive enterprise workloads that do not require local NVMe drives. The instance is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing applications.
